purpose: Prevent common/account-wide buffs from artificially changing relative squad ranking while preserving every differential or objective-specific modifier that can change the recommended composition or placement.

displayPolicy.theoreticalTotals: Sum stored displayed hero values plus explicitly entered Overlord values. Do not add a second layer of buffs that is common to every candidate squad.
displayPolicy.commonBuffWording: Theoretical values: common buffs shared by all squads are not added again.
displayPolicy.rankingWording: Composition and placement are the engine recommendation for the selected objective within the differential effects currently modeled.
displayPolicy.doubleCountingGuard: If a bonus is already baked into the player's displayed ATK/DEF/HP anchor, do not add it again unless the simulator is explicitly modeling a context change that is not represented in those displayed stats.

examples: Drone global ATK/DEF/HP when identical for all compared squads
account-wide decorations/base effects that are already reflected equally
global research lines that affect every candidate identically
classes.reason: They may change absolute battle values but not which candidate squad is relatively best.

examples: gear base stats when already visible in displayed hero stats
classes.specialRule: Wall of Honor is genuinely type-differential. If displayed hero stats already include it, do not add it again; if a future decomposed model uses pre-buff base stats, aggregate the audited per-type Wall values explicitly.

examples: Tank/Missile/Aircraft counter triangle in objectives where counters apply
Crystal Boss daily Defense-hero +20% damage and 5-same-type +30% Attack damage
classes.specialRule: Wanted bosses do not attack, so DEF/HP and defensive Overlord effects have zero offensive ranking weight. Generic monsters do attack, so survival remains a separate constraint.

examples: Memory Ultra Fission type-matched damage amplification
classes.specialRule: Type-matched chip variants and unique presets/resources can change which squad should receive the stronger Drone setup; do not collapse them into a single global Drone Power value.
Provider contribution must be credited even when the provider has lower raw ATK. Positional selectors can change the best front/back arrangement.
Do not model skill damage as a simple raw ATK percentage when the effect depends on cooldown, hit count, target count or team composition.

examples: Bear Totem Tank damage +0.5% per level
Eagle Totem Aircraft damage +0.5% per level
Jaguar Totem Missile damage +0.5% per level
Braz SSR to UR variant change
classes.specialRule: Season 6 temporary hero monster buffs disappear outside Season 6. Braz SSR Zombie Killer must never carry into his UR kit.

examples: Core Cards retained outside the active season
regular Battle Cards active only in their supported seasonal context
classes.specialRule: Use current live card wording over launch-guide wording when the catalog changed during Season 6. Never apply PvP-only card effects to Wanted/Monster PvE unless an in-game source confirms that context.

examples: Joint Attack / Defense Support / Survival Training
classes.specialRule: An owned Overlord can be assigned to only one simultaneous squad. Displayed Overlord Power is never a direct optimization score. Wanted Codes ignore defensive/reactive effects that cannot trigger against a non-attacking boss; direct offensive skill contribution requires calibration.

examples: Area buffs that reward skill/Awakening hit frequency
Non-Core Tactics Card total-level ATK/DEF bonuses
classes.specialRule: Area buffs change by round. Core Cards are excluded from the Non-Core total-level calculation. This objective needs a versioned round/area context rather than a permanent account buff.
Do not inject Resistance into generic Wanted or monster damage unless the selected encounter actually uses the Season 6 virus mechanic.
